setup.js: (() => { const s = document.getElementById('timeline-stage'); const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); const now = Number(s.dataset.uiScale) || 1; const d = -Math.log(1.0 / now) / 0.002; s.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: d, ctrlKey: true, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + 0.5 * r.height, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); })()
(() => { const r = document.getElementById('density'); r.value = '12'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()

actions.js: (() => { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('#separate-tags label')].find((e) => e.textContent.startsWith('host:db-1 ')); if (l) { l.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); l.querySelector('input').checked = true; } })()
